booking.title: Booking Information
booking.partyPersonalDescription: For personal dates, anniversaries, small birthday parties, or intimate meetups, Trend Coffee provides a set menu designed to include drinks, snacks, and desserts, suitable for two people.
booking.partyPersonalThemeDescription: Customers can choose between Romantic Date, Sweet Moment, or Simple & Cozy themes, accompanied by light decorations in their preferred color (fresh flowers, candles, greeting cards, table decor).
booking.partyPersonalDecorationDescription: All items are meticulously prepared to make each date at Trend Coffee a memorable experience.
booking.partyGroupDescription: Trend Coffee is the perfect choice for group gatherings, team building mini parties, company events, class meetings, or small workshops.
booking.partyGroupDescription2: We provide menu design services according to your requirements, including drink combos, light snacks, desserts, or custom menus for each event. The space can be set up flexibly.
booking.partyGroupDescription3: Trend Coffee accompanies businesses and groups to create professional, warm events that reflect the spirit of “dedicated in every product”
booking.bookingContactDescription2: or leave your information on the Trend Coffee and Foods Fanpage for detailed consultation.
